title: Gemini-CLI: Sovereign Fork Divergence
description: Codifies the unique architectural and legislative differences between the DIY-MAKE Sovereign Fork and the Google Gemini CLI baseline.

differences.name: Memory Framework Standardization
differences.rule: Total deprecation of '.gemini/' based memory (GEMINI.md/SOVEREIGN.md). Memory MUST be handled via the multi-repo framework (json/heartwood, json/wedo, py/substrate).
differences.rationale: Ensures substrate safety and prevents 'alien DNA injection' by isolating system-level instructions from ephemeral session state.

differences.name: The Metagit Feed (V8 Replay)
differences.rule: Integrated browser-based replay engine (repos/diy-make/metagit-feed/) for bit-perfect terminal mirroring.
differences.rationale: Provides a forensic visual layer for the swarm, utilizing a 13-Line Linearization Protocol to preserve clean history.

differences.name: Immutable Safety Hardening
differences.rule: Hard-coded source-level blocks for 'rm -rf' and '.git' directory modification in shell-permissions.ts.
differences.rationale: Prevents catastrophic substrate loss and protects the firm's legislative history (Heartwood) regardless of model intent.

differences.name: Metagit Field Optimization
differences.rule: Optimized for 'Object' behavior within the Metagit swarm, enforcing Total Ingestion of JSON DNA at boot.
differences.rationale: Enables seamless cross-generational agent continuity and deep-root forensic searchability across 71+ repositories.
